source.title: The Broncho Buster (unidentified cast or replica)
source.representation: Unchanged selected Objaverse distribution GLB; an unidentified cast or replica after Remington. Uploader-native authoring files and an authenticated current provider download representation are not asserted.
source.attribution: Composition: Frederic Remington, The Broncho Buster. Captured cast or replica and maker unconfirmed. 3D scan: colewharder; CC BY-SA4.0. Preserved Objaverse distribution GLB. Adaptations and generated renders must retain attribution and the share-alike license.

reason: The unchanged source fails essential capture quality. The rider’s face/head region is largely unreadable or absent, with collapsed dark surfaces below the hat instead of the modeled face. Large open/bridged regions around the horse’s hindquarter/leg junction and the rider’s saddle/waist distort the composition. Fine reins and the extended whip are not faithfully captured. These are visible in the native source, before any Atrium serving derivative.
observations: The source retains the broad cowboy-on-rearing-horse silhouette and an oval base, but essential figural detail does not survive.

FRONT and FRONT-THREE-QUARTER show the rider head/face as a large dark, flattened or collapsed region. LEFT and REVERSE do not resolve a complete modeled face. The hat/head outline is heavily deformed.

Large openings and spanned surfaces are visible around the rider’s waist/saddle and horse hindquarter/leg junction. Curled strips replace some thin structural details, and the thin reins/whip visible in the primary composition reference are not retained faithfully.
The outstretched arm is present in the native RIGHT/LEFT views, correcting the weaker thumbnail-only impression that it might be absent. Its fine hand/whip detail remains inadequate.
The base has irregular capture edges and an unrecorded underside, but these peripheral limits are secondary to the missing or distorted figure detail.
Native mode renders the exact preserved distribution GLB directly, retaining its authored unlit textured material. No optimization, new material, source repair or serving derivative caused this hold.
